title: Bai nhap (isPublished=false) van grade/submit duoc qua /api/lessons/{id}/exercises/grade|submit
root_cause: Grade/submit chi kiem tra lesson ton tai qua service, khong goi assertLessonVisible nhu GET /exercises va /content (F88/F89) -> student doc duoc correctAnswer cua bai nhap bang cach gui 1 dap an bat ky va doc truong correctAnswer trong response.
fix: LessonExerciseController: them Authentication + lessonService.assertLessonVisible(lessonId, isAdmin(authentication)) cho ca /grade va /submit.
evidence: sweep/v8/v9-f105-verify.log (6 probe, FAIL=0: student 404, admin preview 200)
verification: Live: POST grade/submit tren draft -> 404 cho user, 200 cho admin; GET published van 200. Backend suite 391/391.

title: POST /api/srs/review tra 500 vinh vien khi srs_interval lon (SM-2 khong co tran)
root_cause: SrsService.reviewWord nhan interval voi easeFactor khong gioi han -> interval tang ~2.6x moi lan review quality>=3; next_review_date = now().plusDays(interval) vuot datetime2 (max 9999-12-31) -> SQLServerException 'One or more values is out of range of values for the datetime2 SQL Server data type' -> HTTP 500, va row khong bao gio tu sua nen moi lan review sau deu 500.
fix: SrsService: MAX_INTERVAL_DAYS = 365 (tran SM-2 chuan) + guard interval<0; row hong tu chua o lan review ke tiep.
evidence: src/test/java/com/datn/engflow/service/AuditV9SrsIntervalOverflowTest.java (3 test, RED truoc fix -> GREEN sau)
docker logs engflow-backend: DataIntegrityViolationException + SQLServerException datetime2
verification: Live: POST /api/srs/review {vocabId:10017,quality:5} 500 -> 200; DB row id=20002 srs_interval 1537216 -> 365, next_review_date 2027-09-17.

title: 'correctAnswer leaked in /exercises response' (harness WARNING)
root_cause: Chan doan cua chinh harness: p2.js do chuoi 'correctAnswer' trong body -> luon khop vi DTO ExerciseResponse luon serialize truong nay, gia tri la null cho caller khong phai admin. Artifact chung minh: p1.json snippet '{"audioUrl":null,"correctAnswer":null,...}' cho exercise 755989.
fix: p2.js: thay substring test bang leakCheck() parse JSON, chi canh bao khi correctAnswer != null. (Hanh vi app dung, khong doi code app.)
verification: p2 rerun 60/60 FAIL=0, khong con WARNING; correctAnswer=null cho guest.

title: GET /api/lessons/{id}/exercises keo lesson.content + content_original (NVARCHAR(MAX)) cho tung dong
root_cause: ExerciseRepository.findByLessonIdOrderByOrderIndexAsc dung 'JOIN FETCH e.lesson' -> moi ExerciseResponse row hydrate ca Lesson entity gom content (max 67 kB) + content_original (max 115 kB). Lesson 651 (99 exercise, content 26 kB + content_original 77 kB): ~5.724 logical reads/goi.
fix: Them projection phang ExerciseLessonProjection + findLessonExercisesProjection(); getExercisesByLesson dung projection (toResponse(projection)); duong grading giu nguyen entity.
verification: Lesson 651 exercise list: HTTP median 153 ms -> 29 ms (max 293 -> 110). Statement cu: 1.054 avg logical reads / 15 ms (48 exec, gom lesson 651; plan xau nhat 197.337 reads / 3.250 ms). Statement moi: 182 avg reads / 0 ms (17 exec). Exec count cua statement cu KHONG tang trong luc do (48 -> 48) => duong list khong con chay no.

title: p4e bao FAIL gia 'admin create (hop le)' do chinh harness khong flush bucket :upload
root_cause: p4e.js tu goi fetch() multipart, bo qua lib.probe() nen khong clear bucket rate_limit ':upload' (15/phut) cua chinh sweep; sau p4c/p4d/p4e trong cung 1 phut thi probe thu 6 bi 429. Do la hanh vi dung cua RateLimitFilter.
fix: p4e.js: lib.flushBucket(':upload') truoc moi multipart POST.
verification: p4e 6/6 FAIL=0 sau fix; 201 'admin create (hop le)'.

title: Vite dev server (container engflow-frontend) ngung phuc vu GET / va GET /src/main.js sau khi chay nhieu gio
root_cause: Sau ~4 gio chay lien tuc cac harness browser, container Vite dev (--host 0.0.0.0) khong con tra loi GET / va GET /src/main.js (curl tra 000 sau 30 s), trong khi GET /index.html va GET /lessons van 200 trong ~40 ms. Xoa node_modules/.vite va restart container KHONG phuc hoi; restart sach + doi server ready thi /index.html lai 200 (54 ms). Chua xac dinh duoc nguyen nhan goc (esbuild service / dep-optimizer / HMR state).
fix: Khong sua code app. Workaround cho harness: load /index.html roi dieu huong CLIENT-side (router link) de khong hoi server duong '/'. Da ap dung trong p21_design_tone_v9.js. Cac harness khac (routes-all, design-v2) da chay xong truoc khi su co xay ra va deu xanh.
verification: Trang thai hien tai: /index.html va client-side routing hoat dong; do la duong da do duoc p21 (ca '/' va '/premium' deu render va do duoc so lieu). BUILD tinh (vite build) khong bi anh huong. Khong ket luan day la loi san pham; day la su co moi truong dev-server, ghi lai de lan sau khong mat thoi gian chan doan lai.
